Three.js 0.186.1, distributed under the MIT license (see LICENSE).

Unmodified browser ES modules from the published `three@0.186.1` npm package:

- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.module.js
- https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.1/build/three.core.js

These files are served locally so the game needs neither a CDN connection nor
a JavaScript build step. Keep both modules on the same version when upgrading.
